defaultParameters.description: Sound to be played while the text is being typed

commands.description: Shows text in typewriting effect. Printing letter by letter.
commands.name: Show Text

description:
Prints messages letter by letter, giving it a typewriter effect. To add typewriting text, just use this plugin's "Show Text" command (NOT the default "Show Text" command) and tweak the parameters to your liking. To remove the text box, use "Remove A Picture" command. The ID of picture has to be same as ID of the box.

Original plugin by SpunkyAmbassador (https://github.com/SpunkyAmbassador/Typewriter-Text), now maintained by Russo (https://github.com/yaleksander/Typewriter-Text)
name: Typewriter Text
